description: A quiet, sunlit apartment on the third floor, two minutes on foot from the park. The living room opens onto a small balcony where you can have breakfast facing the trees. The bedroom has a 180 cm king bed with hotel-quality linen, blackout curtains and a reading lamp on each side. The kitchen is fully equipped for real cooking: oven, dishwasher, espresso machine, and basic supplies. A dedicated workspace with a fast fibre connection makes remote work easy, and the bathroom has a walk-in shower with strong water pressure. Self check-in, luggage drop-off on request, and a host who answers in under an hour.
